title: Keep package.json and package-lock.json synchronized

match.value: npm ci can only install|package.json and package-lock.json are not in sync|Missing: .+ from lock file

failureExamples: npm error npm ci can only install packages when your package.json and package-lock.json are in sync. Missing: example@1.0.0 from lock file

guidance.when: A dependency was intentionally added, removed, or upgraded.
guidance.solution: Use the required Node and npm toolchain to regenerate the lockfile, then review the dependency diff and rerun npm ci.
guidance.tradeoffs: Manual lockfile edits are fragile and can conceal transitive changes.

guidance.when: package.json changed accidentally or during conflict resolution.
guidance.solution: Restore only the unintended manifest change and keep the existing lockfile.
guidance.tradeoffs: Regenerating the lockfile in this case creates unrelated dependency churn.
